title: HR Business Partner
description:
**People \& Culture Business Partner** \[Pune \- Onsite]


**Who Are We**
==============

Hansen Technologies (ASX: HSN) is a global software and services provider, serving energy, water/utilities, and telecommunications industries. With customers in 80\+ countries, we foster collaboration across 26 global offices. From 5G advancements to renewable energy transitions, we empower customers to overcome challenges, innovate, and drive new business models.


At Hansen, we are also embedding AI enablement across our operations. From automating workflows and enhancing service delivery, to driving innovation in customer solutions, AI is shaping the next chapter of how we support our clients. With a focus on operational excellence and innovation, Hansen is using AI not just as a tool, but as a strategic enabler to deliver smarter, faster, and more resilient solutions for the future.  



**Why This Role Matters**
=========================

Be the trusted HR partner. Enable business success. Shape a competitive reward strategy.


As the HR Business Partner – India, you will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Hansen’s Compensation \& Benefits strategy for the region. Working closely with business leaders, Finance, and the global HR team, you will ensure that our reward programs are market\-aligned, compliant, and designed to attract, retain, and motivate top talent while supporting business growth.


Beyond advisory HR support, this role is pivotal in driving compensation benchmarking, benefits administration, and payroll governance, ensuring accuracy, equity, and a positive employee experience. Your expertise will directly influence how we reward performance, support employee wellbeing, and maintain Hansen’s position as an employer of choice in a competitive talent market.  



**What You’ll Do**
==================

* Act as the primary HR partner for India\-based teams and global stakeholders
* Lead Compensation \& Benefits activities including benchmarking, benefits administration, and reward support
* Ensure payroll inputs, employee data, and HR governance are accurate and compliant
* Provide expert guidance on HR policies, employee relations, performance, and disciplinary matters
* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws and regulatory requirements
* Support global HR cycles such as performance reviews, REM, engagement surveys, and audits
Collaborate cross‑regionally on global HR initiatives and continuous improvement.  
* 

**What You Bring**
==================

* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Proven experience in an HR role, preferably as an HR Business Partner or HR Executive
* Strong knowledge of employment laws, regulations, and HR best practices in India
* Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and integrity
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive with a positive, can\-do approach.  
* 

This is full\-time onsite role based in our Pune office.  



**What Sets You Apart**
=======================

* Experience working within global or matrixed organizations
* Hands\-on experience with HRIS/HCM systems (Oracle or SAP preferred)
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.  
* 

**Benefits and Perks**
======================

Join us for a rewarding career with competitive compensation, leave entitlements, health coverage, and financial security. Enjoy work\-life balance, growth, and recognition for your exceptional performance. Our team will unveil the intricacies of our benefit package during the selection process.  



**Contact Us**
==============

If you possess the desired skills and enthusiasm, please “Apply Now” via the link or visit our career page.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status *.*

Visit our website at hansencx.com for more information.  



**Data Privacy Notice**
=======================

By applying to this role, you consent to Hansen collecting, processing, and storing the information you provide for recruitment purposes. You also agree that your details may be securely retained in our talent database for future opportunities and reference in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

Pigment is the AI\-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature\-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.

With a team of 500\+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top\-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.  


We're offering a great position for a **Compensation and Benefits Manager** to join the People team. So, if you’ve got a way with Human Resources in a challenging environment and a genuine desire to build a first\-class People organization, we'd love to hear from you!

Reporting directly to our Head of People, this role will be responsible for managing the entire **Compensation \& Benefits strategy and execution, for all our markets.**
### **Who You Are:**


* You have significant experience in Compensation \& Benefits (8 years at least), and an in\-depth knowledge of C\&B practices, notably of the North American market
* You have worked in a fast\-growing and in an international environment
* You are structured and thorough with strong attention to details and data accuracy
* You are able to communicate efficiently and can make complicated concepts seem simple
* You are fun and enthusiastic, excited about being a core member of a rockstar team!
### **What You Will Do:**


* Upgrade our C\&B strategy (including equity) to attract and retain our talents, notably by benchmarking our practices with the best\-in class Tech companies
* Update and maintain our compensation ranges according to our strategy
* Manage our equity attributions
* Ensure our Benefits’ competitiveness, while keeping Pigment’s strategy and stage in mind
* Regular meetings and negotiations with Benefits providers, and handling relationships with them
* Deploy \& manage the annual increases’ process worldwide in the Pigment Application.
* Automate and optimize our C\&B processes, campaigns \& workflows
* Participate in global projects such as budget definition, forecasts and ad\-hoc analysis.
### **How we work**


* Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet
* Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
* Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission
* Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment
* Champion our Customers: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our Customers heroes in their organizations
### **What we offer**

* Competitive compensation package
* Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
* We encourage you to take the time you need. When you work hard, we know you also need to rest, which is why we offer generous time off and parental leave policies
* Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, Toronto, Paris, and London
* High\-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
$200 \- $240 a year

Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.*

*Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. title: Digital HR Analyst
description:
**Position Title:** Digital HR Analyst

**Position Type:** Regular \- Full\-Time


**Requisition ID:** 41957

 **Role Overview**


The Digital HR Analyst supports the design, configuration, testing, and optimization of HR technology systems whether through hands on implementation or strong business partnering with Technology resources. This role focuses on system functionality, access governance, elevated troubleshooting, and continuous enhancement.


This role is ideal for someone with strong hands\-on HR technology experience, playing a larger role in system configuration of HR processes, can communicate strongly to ensure HR needs translate into sound system logic and influence design, enjoys working cross functionally and has strong project management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**.

**Driving Technology Advancement**

* **Appropriately solve** HR problems with sustainable technical solutions in line with HR strategy, proactively managing impacts across systems, people and process.
* **Configure and maintain HR systems according to requirements,** updating settings, foundational data, workflows and security roles with precision.
* Serve as a **key escalation point for complex system issues**, partnering with IT and vendors to troubleshoot and resolve root causes.
* Own the **full UAT lifecycle** for their enhancements, including test script development, tester coordination, and validation that system updates support accurate and efficient business processes. Documents results, mitigates risks before deployment, identifies change impacts requiring communication or training, and surfaces process gaps to guide future enhancements.
* **Identify opportunities for automation in HR** processes and helps design and test workflow logic.
* Support system releases to ensure smooth deployment of mandatory and optional changes; identifying and mitigating impacts, sharing recommendations, and assisting with change management efforts,

 **Access Management**

* **Configure role\-based access structures** approved via governance or partners with necessary resources to do so, defining permission logic in line with the role.
* **Partner with IT** to align HR systems with **enterprise security standards**.

**User Enablement**

* **Keep clear and consistent technical documentation, job aids and user guides updated**, ensuring relevance and health of HR technology content.
* **Contributing content to, and answering questions from, Digital Training initiatives** to support HR staff in interacting with our technology.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

* **Provide expert input on system capabilities, constraints, and configuration options** related to prioritized strategic initiatives.
* **Facilitate working sessions** to gather requirements, validate designs, and resolve issues where required.
* **Represent HR in digital or process improvement initiatives** as a subject matter contributor.

 **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 3\-5 years of hands\-on HR Technology or business analyst experience.
* Certification in one or more of our key HR platforms (Time and attendance platform (UKG Workforce Pro is Preferred) and ServiceNow, Phenom, SuccessFactors).
* Strong understanding of HR processes (employee lifecycle, onboarding, timekeeping, talent management, performance, etc.)
* Proven ability to identify and manage change impacts of technology redesign.
* Strong ability to analyze issues, conduct root cause analysis and provide technically sound and sustainable solutions to problems, proactively mitigating impacts.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with cross functional teams.
* Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
* Enhancement coordination from facilitating requirement building for large process areas, design blueprinting, configuration, unit testing, user acceptance testing, change, deployment, operationalization.

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience working in an **agile** manner, i.e. **sprint\-based execution**.
* Experience using Agile tools to track work.

 **What Success Looks Like**

* **System changes deployed smoothly** with fewer defects and minimal post\-release issues because validation is thorough and aligned with business processes.
* **Recurring issues trend downward** because root causes are being addressed.
* **UAT cycles run efficiently**, with clear scripts, coordinated testers, and well documented results. **Defects are caught early**, reducing rework and preventing production disruptions.
* **Adoption improves** because systems are configured to meet broad business problems, have sustainable solutions the support HR processes, there are fewer process breakdowns and increased user experience.
* **SOPs, test scripts and configuration notes are current**, reducing knowledge gaps, streamlining project discovery and operations are more predictable/scalable.
* You are recognized as a trusted problem solver and **reliable partner** who understands both HR processes and technology.

title: HR Compliance Senior Associate
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Overview**


The India HR Compliance Senior Associate is responsible for ensuring adherence to Indian employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies across our India operations. This role focuses on managing employment\-related compliance processes, supporting policy governance as well as the employee life cycle, and mitigating risk through proactive monitoring and advisory. The position partners with HR Compliance leadership, Talent Business Advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure compliant and consistent HR practices in alignment with central and state labor laws.


This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast\-evolving compliance landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Employment Law Compliance, Reporting \& Policy Governance**

* Support compliance with key Indian labor law requirements, including but not limited to:


	+ Gratuity Act
	+ Shops \& Establishments Act (state\-specific)
	+ POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Act
	+ Leave\-related statutory provisions
	+ Severance and separation\-related compliance
* Update and communicate HR policies, procedures, and applicable Indian labor laws (central and state\-specific) to employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Support the review and maintenance of the India Employee Handbook to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Shops \& Establishments Acts, Industrial Employment regulations).
* Drive compliance program execution, including POSH awareness, training coordination, documentation, and audit readiness across office locations.
* Under the guidance of the India HR Compliance leader, provide support on policy interpretation in complex scenarios, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements and internal governance frameworks.
* Respond to employee and leadership queries related to HR policies, employment law, and compliance requirements.
* Identify compliance gaps and assist in drafting, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement of compliance processes, controls, and systems.
* Ensure audit readiness for internal and external compliance reviews, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting, including maintaining accurate documentation and timely submissions.
* Assist in preparing employment\-related documentation such as employment verification letters, compliance certifications, and policy communications.
* Support compliance awareness initiatives (e.g., HR Connect sessions) to promote understanding of policies and legal obligations.

**Time Off (Leave) Compliance – EL / CL / SL**

* Manage compliance aspects of employee time\-off programs, including Earned Leave (EL), Casual Leave (CL), and Sick Leave (SL), ensuring alignment with applicable state laws and company policy.
* Support leave tracking and compliance with statutory accruals, carry\-forward, and encashment rules.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on time\-off policies and ensure consistent application across the organization.
* Partner with HR systems teams to ensure accurate configuration and compliance of leave policies within HRIS platforms.

**Employee Relations \& HR Life Cycle Support**

* Escalate and support employee relations matters under the guidance of the HR Compliance Talent Relations leader, and in partnership with the Talent Business Advisor (TBA) team.
* Partner with the Talent Relations leader and Workplace Investigations team, as applicable, to ensure adherence to legal requirements and internal protocols regarding employee relations matters.
* Support governance of and ensure compliance with exit processes and employee separations, including adherence to applicable labor laws and statutory notice requirements, documentation standards, and internal processes.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 4\-7\+ years of relevant experience in HR compliance, employee relations, or HR operations within India.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory frameworks, including central and state\-specific regulations including Shops \& Establishments Acts.
* Experience supporting compliance programs such as POSH, gratuity, leave policies, and employee lifecycle compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply legal and policy requirements in practical business scenarios.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail with experience in audits, documentation, and compliance tracking.

**Core Competencies**

**Job Description:**

**Overview**


The India HR Compliance Senior Associate is responsible for ensuring adherence to Indian employment laws, statutory requirements, and internal HR policies across our India operations. This role focuses on managing employment\-related compliance processes, supporting policy governance as well as the employee life cycle, and mitigating risk through proactive monitoring and advisory. The position partners with HR Compliance leadership, Talent Business Advisors, and key stakeholders to ensure compliant and consistent HR practices in alignment with central and state labor laws.


This position requires strong regulatory knowledge and critical thinking skills, analytical judgement, the highest level of confidentiality and discretion, and the ability to operate effectively and efficiently in a fast\-evolving compliance landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Employment Law Compliance, Reporting \& Policy Governance**

* Support compliance with key Indian labor law requirements, including but not limited to:


	+ Gratuity Act
	+ Shops \& Establishments Act (state\-specific)
	+ POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Act
	+ Leave\-related statutory provisions
	+ Severance and separation\-related compliance
* Update and communicate HR policies, procedures, and applicable Indian labor laws (central and state\-specific) to employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Support the review and maintenance of the India Employee Handbook to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements (e.g., Shops \& Establishments Acts, Industrial Employment regulations).
* Drive compliance program execution, including POSH awareness, training coordination, documentation, and audit readiness across office locations.
* Under the guidance of the India HR Compliance leader, provide support on policy interpretation in complex scenarios, ensuring alignment with statutory requirements and internal governance frameworks.
* Respond to employee and leadership queries related to HR policies, employment law, and compliance requirements.
* Identify compliance gaps and assist in drafting, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement of compliance processes, controls, and systems.
* Ensure audit readiness for internal and external compliance reviews, audits, inspections, and compliance reporting, including maintaining accurate documentation and timely submissions.
* Assist in preparing employment\-related documentation such as employment verification letters, compliance certifications, and policy communications.
* Support compliance awareness initiatives (e.g., HR Connect sessions) to promote understanding of policies and legal obligations.

**Time Off (Leave) Compliance – EL / CL / SL**

* Manage compliance aspects of employee time\-off programs, including Earned Leave (EL), Casual Leave (CL), and Sick Leave (SL), ensuring alignment with applicable state laws and company policy.
* Support leave tracking and compliance with statutory accruals, carry\-forward, and encashment rules.
* Provide guidance to employees and managers on time\-off policies and ensure consistent application across the organization.
* Partner with HR systems teams to ensure accurate configuration and compliance of leave policies within HRIS platforms.

**Employee Relations \& HR Life Cycle Support**

* Escalate and support employee relations matters under the guidance of the HR Compliance Talent Relations leader, and in partnership with the Talent Business Advisor (TBA) team.
* Partner with the Talent Relations leader and Workplace Investigations team, as applicable, to ensure adherence to legal requirements and internal protocols regarding employee relations matters.
* Support governance of and ensure compliance with exit processes and employee separations, including adherence to applicable labor laws and statutory notice requirements, documentation standards, and internal processes.

**Qualifications and Requirements**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Legal Studies, or related field.
* 4\-7\+ years of relevant experience in HR compliance, employee relations, or HR operations within India.
* Experience within professional services, consulting, or multinational organizations preferred.

**Specialized Knowledge**

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor laws and statutory frameworks, including central and state\-specific regulations including Shops \& Establishments Acts.
* Experience supporting compliance programs such as POSH, gratuity, leave policies, and employee lifecycle compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply legal and policy requirements in practical business scenarios.
* Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive investigations or escalations with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail with experience in audits, documentation, and compliance tracking.

* **Judgement and Integrity:** Demonstrates strong ethical and sound decision\-making and uses the highest level of discretion and confidentiality in sensitive matters.
* **Analytical \& Problem\-Solving:** Ability to interpret complex regulations and resolve issues with minimal supervision.

description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Team Lead – Recruitment \& Operations is a high\-energy, execution\-focused role at Honest Hire. The primary responsibility is to lead a team of recruiters, drive daily hiring activity, and ensure monthly closure targets are consistently met. This person will also support HR operations deliverables for client accounts. We are not looking for someone who just manages — we need someone who rolls up their sleeves, pushes the team, and owns outcomes. If you are energetic, target\-driven, and have a solid grip on recruitment with some exposure to HR operations, this role is built for you.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Recruitment Management**

▪ Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for client mandates across industries including manufacturing, construction, IT, retail, and services.

▪ Ensure a minimum of 30 position closures per month across all client accounts.

▪ Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed), employee referrals, headhunting, and talent databases.

▪ Conduct first\-level screening, competency\-based shortlisting, and coordinate interview scheduling with clients.

▪ Maintain and optimize JD quality, sourcing pipelines, and ATS data hygiene across all open positions.

▪ Track weekly sourcing metrics, submission ratios, interview\-to\-offer rates, and closure timelines per recruiter.

**B. HR Operations**

▪ Oversee HR operations deliverables for Honest Hire's client accounts including onboarding, documentation, offer letters, appointment letters, and HR policy rollouts.

▪ Coordinate payroll inputs (attendance, variable pay, new joiners, exits) with the payroll team and ensure timely monthly processing.

▪ Ensure all statutory compliance TATs are met — PF, ESIC, PT, TDS — with zero delays or errors.

▪ Manage employee lifecycle documentation: contracts, confirmation letters, increment letters, exit paperwork, and Full \& Final settlements.

▪ Handle client\-side HR escalations with ownership and timely resolution.

**C. Team Management**

▪ Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 3–5 recruiters and HR executives with weekly target setting and performance reviews.

▪ Conduct daily standups to track pipeline status, bottlenecks, and closures.

▪ Provide structured coaching and feedback; identify skill gaps and ensure continuous learning.

▪ Maintain team accountability through defined KPIs and weekly MIS reporting to the Founder.

**D. Client Management \& Business Support**

▪ Act as the primary SPOC for all recruitment and operations client accounts — own the relationship, communication, and SLA adherence.

▪ Share weekly and monthly MIS reports with clients covering hiring progress, ops compliance status, and escalation summaries.

▪ Identify upselling opportunities — e.g., converting a recruitment client to an HR operations client or vice versa.

▪ Support the Founder in onboarding new clients by setting up workflows, documentation frameworks, and team assignments quickly.

▪ Participate in client review meetings and business development discussions as required.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

▪ MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent (full\-time preferred).

▪ 3–7 years of experience in recruitment and HR operations, with at least 2 years in a team\-leading role.

▪ Proven track record of meeting bulk or high\-volume hiring targets (25\+ closures/month) in a consultancy or corporate setup.

▪ Hands\-on experience in HR operations: documentation, payroll inputs, and statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS).

▪ Experience working with small to mid\-size businesses or in an RPO/HR consultancy environment preferred.

▪ Languages: English \& Hindi (Marathi is an advantage).

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

▪ Prior experience in an HR consultancy, RPO, or staffing firm setup.

▪ Familiarity with ATS / HRMS platforms and structured recruitment reporting.

▪ Working knowledge of Labour Law, PF, ESIC, and PT compliance basics.

▪ Exposure to payroll coordination and full \& final settlement processes.

▪ Strong MS Excel and MIS reporting skills — ability to build and maintain dashboards.

▪ Network of candidates across industries: manufacturing, logistics, construction, retail, and IT.

title: Junior Plant & Machinery Valuation Engineer
description:
***Only freshers / students in last year should apply for this position.***

**Junior Valuer:**

As a junior plant and machinery valuer, your job profile would involve learning and assisting senior valuers in various aspects of the valuation process. Here's an overview of what your role might entail:

* **Assistance in Inspections**: You would assist senior valuers in conducting inspections of machinery and equipment. This involves learning how to assess the condition, functionality, and overall quality of the assets.
* **Data Collection**: Gathering relevant information and data about the machinery and equipment being valued. This could include specifications, maintenance records, usage history, and other pertinent details.
* **Market Research Support**: Assisting in market research activities to gather information on industry trends, pricing data, and comparable sales to help determine the market value of the assets.
* **Documentation and Record\-keeping**: Learning how to maintain accurate records and documentation of valuation activities, including inspection reports, data sheets, photographs, and other relevant documents.
* **Data Analysis**: Supporting senior valuers in analysing collected data and information to help determine the appropriate valuation methodologies and approaches to be used.
* **Report Preparation**: Assisting in the preparation of valuation reports under the guidance of senior valuers. This may involve compiling data, drafting sections of the report, and ensuring that all necessary information is included.
* **Client Interaction**: Learning how to effectively communicate with clients to understand their valuation needs, gather additional information, and provide updates on the valuation process.
* **Continued Learning**: Actively engaging in ongoing training and professional development activities to expand your knowledge of valuation methodologies, industry standards, and relevant regulations.
* **Quality Assurance**: Participating in quality assurance processes to ensure that valuation reports meet the required standards of accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
* **Team Collaboration**: Collaborating with other team members, including senior valuers, engineers, and administrative staff, to ensure smooth coordination and execution of valuation projects.

Overall, as a junior plant and machinery valuer, your role would involve learning the ropes of the valuation process, gaining hands\-on experience under the guidance of experienced professionals, and gradually taking on more responsibilities as you develop your skills and expertise in the field.

**Job Title: VP – Customer Success**

**Location:** Bengaluru / India (with travel as required)  
**Organization:** Janitri Innovations Pvt. Ltd.  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**About Janitri**

Janitri is a fast\-growing health\-tech company dedicated to improving maternal and newborn outcomes through innovative medical devices and digital health solutions. Our products are deployed across hospitals and healthcare systems, impacting thousands of pregnancies and births.

Over the years, Janitri has built a strong presence across **public and private healthcare ecosystems**, working closely with clinicians, hospitals, and government programs. With multiple recognitions and a growing footprint, we are now entering a **high\-growth phase focused on scale, adoption, and deeper impact**.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **VP – Customer Success** who can build and scale a **technology\-driven customer success function** that ensures strong adoption, retention, and impact across both enterprise healthcare customers and end users.

This role requires someone who understands that customer success is not just relationship management — it is about **building systems, leveraging technology, and driving outcomes at scale**.

You will work closely with product, clinical, sales, and operations teams to ensure our solutions are effectively adopted and deliver measurable value across both **B2B (hospitals, doctors)** and **B2C (end users / patients)** segments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the **end\-to\-end customer lifecycle** — onboarding, implementation, adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion.
* Build and scale a **tech\-enabled customer success function**, including CRM systems, automation, dashboards, and customer health tracking.
* Drive **product adoption and utilization** across hospitals, clinicians, and end users.
* Design scalable onboarding, training, and engagement journeys for both enterprise customers and consumer users.
* Ensure high **customer retention, satisfaction, and lifetime value** across segments.
* Build and lead a high\-performing **Customer Success team**, including field teams, onboarding specialists, and account managers.
* Develop structured **customer feedback loops** and work closely with product and engineering teams to improve offerings.
* Monitor and optimize key metrics such as **NPS, retention, activation, engagement, and usage**.
* Identify risks proactively and ensure resolution to maintain strong customer relationships.
* Collaborate with sales and business teams to drive **upsell and cross\-sell opportunities**.
* Build deep relationships with hospital leadership, doctors, partners, and ecosystem stakeholders.
* Drive customer success strategies across both **public health programs and private healthcare institutions**.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* A leader who has **built or scaled customer success using technology and systems**, not just manual processes.
* Experience managing both **enterprise (B2B)** and **consumer (B2C)** customer success journeys.
* Strong understanding of **customer lifecycle, engagement, retention, and product adoption at scale**.
* Experience in **high\-growth environments**, building processes from scratch.
* Ability to balance **strategy with execution** in a fast\-paced setup.
* Strong stakeholder management across internal teams and external customers.
* High ownership mindset with a focus on outcomes and impact.

**Experience \& Qualification**

* 10–15 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, or Key Account Management.
* Proven experience in **building tech\-enabled customer success systems (CRM, automation, analytics tools)**.
* Experience in **healthcare, medtech, SaaS, or consumer tech platforms** preferred.
* Demonstrated exposure to both **enterprise customers and consumer\-facing products/services**.
* Experience leading and scaling teams across geographies.

**Why This Role Matters**

At Janitri, customer success directly translates to **clinical outcomes and lives impacted**. This role will define how our products are adopted, used, and scaled across healthcare systems and end users — making it one of the most critical leadership roles in the organization.

description:
* Min. 1 to 3 years experience
* Surat (GJ), India

#### **About Us**

* Optimumbrew Technology LLP is a fast\-growing IT company specializing in innovative, user\-focused mobile and web application development. Backed by a strong **“Get Things Done”** culture, we bring together top engineering talent to deliver high\-quality digital solutions for clients across the **USA, Canada, UK, Australia**, and other global markets. We focus on creativity, technology, and long\-term partnerships to help businesses achieve meaningful digital growth.
#### **Job Description**

* We are looking for a **Creative Content Creator \& Brand Storyteller** who can transform ideas into compelling narratives and produce content that drives attention, emotion, and engagement.
* You will play a key role in shaping how our brand speaks, looks, and connects with audiences across digital platforms.
#### **Primary Objectives**

* Develop and execute compelling brand storytelling that builds strong emotional connections with the target audience.
* Create high\-quality, engaging, and platform\-specific content that drives **attention, engagement, and brand recall**.
* Establish and maintain a **consistent brand voice and narrative** across all digital channels.
* Leverage **consumer psychology, trends, and data insights** to craft impactful content strategies.
* Experiment with innovative content formats and storytelling techniques to improve reach and engagement.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align content with **marketing goals and business objectives**.
* Continuously optimize content performance using analytics, feedback, and creative iterations.
#### **Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Develop compelling stories, scripts, and content concepts for brand, product, and marketing campaigns.
* Produce high\-quality content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, website, blogs, and marketing videos.
* Craft emotionally engaging narratives using audience psychology and empathy\-driven communication.
* Conduct market, competitor, and trend research to identify fresh content opportunities and insights.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to ideate, structure, and refine creative content experiences.
* Create and experiment with trending content formats: reels, shorts, memes, storytelling videos, hooks, and visual narratives.
* Collaborate with designers, product managers, and marketing teams to execute cohesive content strategies.
* Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) for content research, ideation, concept building, and scriptwriting.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice, tone, and visual storytelling style across all digital touchpoints.
* Track performance metrics (views, engagement, watch\-time, shares) and recommend creative improvements.
* Assist in planning and executing creative campaigns that strengthen brand image and audience connection.
* Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, audience expectations, and communication objectives.
#### **Technical Skills You Should Have**

* Strong command of scriptwriting, storytelling, and narrative structuring for digital platforms.
* Proficiency in creating content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, websites, and blogs.
* Understanding of consumer psychology, emotional communication, and engagement\-driven content creation.
* Ability to use AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) for ideation, research, and content enhancement.
* Familiarity with short\-form video formats, hooks, pacing, and visual storytelling techniques.
* Basic knowledge of video editing tools (Premiere Pro, CapCut, VN, or similar) is an added advantage.
* Ability to conduct market research, competitor analysis, and trend identification.
* Strong grasp of social media algorithms, content patterns, and best\-performing formats.
* Experience in writing SEO\-friendly blog content (optional but beneficial).
* Ability to collaborate using tools like Notion, Google Workspace, Figma, or project management platforms.
#### **Key Expertise**

* Storytelling \& Scriptwriting: Ability to craft compelling narratives, hooks, and emotional scripts for digital platforms.
* Creative Concept Development: Skilled in generating unique ideas, content angles, and storytelling formats.
* Social Media Content Creation: Strong understanding of creating platform\-specific content for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and blogs.
* Audience Psychology: Ability to decode user emotions, motivations, and behaviors to create relatable content.
* Trend Identification: Expertise in analyzing and leveraging social media trends, formats, and viral patterns.
* Visual Thinking: Strong sense of visual storytelling, scene setup, pacing, and message flow.
* AI\-Assisted Creativity: Proficient in using AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) for ideation, scriptwriting, and content enhancement.
* Market \& Competitor Research: Ability to identify industry gaps, opportunities, and creative direction ideas.
* Content Optimization: Skilled in improving engagement through hooks, structure, captions, CTAs, and formats.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Ability to work closely with design, product, and marketing teams for seamless execution.
#### **Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mass Communication, Marketing, Psychology, Design, Journalism, Media Studies, or related fields (preferred but not mandatory).
* 1–3 years of experience in content creation, digital storytelling, social media content, or creative strategy.
* Strong portfolio showcasing storytelling skills, content creativity, and digital platform understanding.
* Exceptional freshers with a strong Instagram presence, creative portfolio, or storytelling samples are encouraged to apply.
#### **Experience**

* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in content creation, storytelling, social media content, or digital marketing.
* Experience producing content for platforms like Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, websites, and blogs.
* Prior experience in creating scripts, short\-form videos, reels/shorts, or brand narratives is highly preferred.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams (design, product, marketing) to execute creative ideas.
* Exceptional freshers with a strong creative portfolio or high\-engagement Instagram presence may also apply.
#### **Benefits**

* 22 Paid Leaves

* Health Insurance

* Statutory Benefits (PF \& ESIC)
* Salary on time
* Yearly Picnic
* Annual Sports Day
* Monthly Events
* Festival Celebrations

**About Fleetoz Solutions Pvt. Ltd.**

Fleetoz Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a technology\-driven company providing **SaaS\-based software solutions for corporate transportation and fleet management operations**. The Fleetoz platform helps organizations efficiently manage employee transportation, vendor management, trip scheduling, driver allocation, and billing processes through a centralized digital system.

The platform is designed to support **corporate mobility providers, car rental companies, and organizations managing employee transport operations**. Fleetoz enables companies to improve operational efficiency, transparency, and service quality through **real\-time tracking, automation, and data\-driven reporting**.

Fleetoz Solutions supports clients **across multiple cities in India and globally**, focusing on innovation, technology\-driven mobility solutions, and long\-term client partnerships.

**Role Overview**

The **Software Sales \& Trainer** will be responsible for promoting, selling, and supporting the **Fleetoz software platform** used for managing corporate transportation operations.

The role involves **generating software sales opportunities, conducting product demonstrations, closing yearly software licensing agreements with corporate clients and vendor partners, and providing system training to ensure proper software utilization**.

The candidate will act as the **primary point of contact for software\-related training, onboarding, and solution support for both corporate clients and car rental vendors**.

**Software Sales \& Business Development**

* Promote and sell **Fleetoz software solutions** to corporate clients and car rental vendors.
* Conduct **cold calls, outreach, and follow\-ups** to generate software sales opportunities.
* Identify potential **corporate clients and vendor partners** who can benefit from the Fleetoz platform.
* Close **yearly software licensing agreements** with clients and vendors.
* Support the sales team in **software presentations and product demonstrations**.

**Software Demonstration \& Client Engagement**

* Conduct **software demonstrations and presentations** for prospective clients and vendor partners.
* Explain system features such as **trip management, vendor management, driver management, billing integration, and reporting tools**.
* Highlight the **operational and efficiency benefits** of using the Fleetoz platform.

**Software Training \& Implementation**

* Provide **software utilization training** to corporate clients and car rental vendors after onboarding.
* Conduct training sessions for **internal teams including operations, billing, supply, and account management**.
* Prepare **training materials, SOPs, and user guides** for system usage.
* Ensure clients and vendors understand the **complete workflow and features of the platform**.

**Client \& Vendor Support**

* Act as the **single point of contact for software\-related training, support, and solution guidance**.
* Assist clients and vendors in **system adoption and effective usage of the platform**.
* Address **basic system queries** and coordinate with the technical team for issue resolution.
* Gather **user feedback to improve system processes and features**.

**Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain records of **software sales activities, licensing agreements, and training sessions**.
* Track **software adoption and usage by clients and vendors**.
* Prepare reports related to **software sales pipeline, onboarding progress, and training completion**.

**Candidate Profile**
